description:
A BillPaymentCheckAdd request must include either `payment_amount`, `set_credit`, or `discount_amount` (or more than one of these). If none of these three is included, the SDK will return an error.

The `bill_payment_check_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

applied_amount.description: Amount of a credit that is applied to a customer’s invoice, or amount of a payment that is applied to a particular bill or vendor credit.

exchange_rate.description: `exchange_rate` is the rate from this currency to the company’s home currency at AsOfDate. You can supply a rate when adding transactions, but QuickBooks does not provide rates through the SDK.

external_guid.description: Allows for the attachment of a user defined GUID value.

is_to_be_printed.description:
If `is_to_be_printed` is true, QuickBooks queues the form for later printing. It does not print immediately; printing is still a user action in QuickBooks.

Choose exactly one of: `is_to_be_printed`, or `ref_number`.

payee_entity_ref.description: `payee_entity_ref` identifies the payee (customer, vendor, employee, or Other Name). If both `full_name` and `list_id` are provided, `full_name` is ignored.

txn_date.description: The date of the transaction. In some cases, if you leave `txn_date` out of an -Add message, QuickBooks will prefill `txn_date` with the date of the last-saved transaction of the same type.
